name: sqt-reverse-engineer
description: Reverse-engineering toolkit that mirrors the REA architecture — one entry skill routes to per-target modules (JavaScript/Electron apps, native binaries, .NET assemblies, websites, Android APKs), every conclusion must carry evidence and stated limitations, and findings end in an explanation or a rebuildable implementation. Uses the REA engine (npx rea-agents) when available, with manual static-analysis fallbacks. For software you own or are authorized to examine only.
